title: Enigma ya Kiti ya Bokonzi oyo ezali mosika
intro: Mokonzi moko ya nguya, oyo apambolamaki na bokonzi ya kokamwa, akutanaki na mokakatano moko ya kokamwa oyo etali mokonzi-mwasi moko oyo autaki na mokili moko ya mosika. Mokonzi alukaki kolakisa nguya mpe bwanya ya bonzambe, mpe abandisaki likambo moko ya kokamwa oyo eboyaki mibeko ya ntango mpe ya esika. Okoki kozwa makanisi mikemike ya likambo yango ya likamwisi?
clues: Bapesaki mokonzi nguya monene, na ndakisa bokonzi likoló na bikelamu oyo emonanaka te mpe likoki ya kotambwisa mipɛpɛ.
Mokonzi oyo azwaki nsango ya mokonzi mwasi moko ya bozwi oyo azalaki kosambela moi, mpe azwaki ekateli ya kobengisa ye na ndako ya mokonzi.
Liboso ete mokonzi-mwasi aya, mokonzi yango amonisaki mposa ya komema kiti na ye ya nguya ya kokamwa uta na bokonzi na ye oyo ezalaki mosika.
Jinn moko ya nguya alobaki ete akozwa eloko yango liboso ete mokonzi atɛlɛma na lisangani na ye.
Kasi, moto oyo azalaki na boyebi mozindo ya Makomami ya Bonzambe apesaki nzela ya kozwa yango nokinoki koleka, mpe asilisaki mosala yango na mbala moko.
Ntango ekómaki, mokonzi apesaki mitindo ete bábongola eloko yango mpo na komeka mayele mpe bososoli ya mokonzi-mwasi ntango nsukansuka akómaki na ndako ya mokonzi.

verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
